text:
Priya: Quick ping — 3pm final round candidate is on in 45m. Need quick confirmations on roles and debrief lead.
Maya: I'll take debrief lead and capture notes. I'll set the doc link.
Leo: I'll be interviewer 2, can cover system design. Need mic test + shared whiteboard link?
Samir: I'll be interviewer 1 (behavioral). Can someone confirm whether we want the 'product fit' rubic to be weighted 20% or 15%?
Priya: Good Q. People Ops advised 15% for product fit, 60% for technical + signaling. @Jordan can you confirm?
Jordan: Confirmed — rubric weights are 60% technical, 15% product, 25% collaboration/communication. Use the latest scorecard template.
Interview Bot: Reminder scheduled — candidate calendar invites sent, Zoom recording disabled per candidate request.
Elena: Candidate asked for a quick accessibility note — prefers slides in advance. Priya, did we send the slide request email?
Priya: Not yet, sending now. Copying the template:
```Subject: Slides for interview
Hi <Candidate>,
If you plan to share slides or a demo, please upload or email them to priya@redwood.ai 30 minutes before the interview. Thanks!
``` 
Maya: Also a small timing note — please keep each interview block to 25m, 5m wrap, and leave 15m for debrief. Timekeeper = Leo? Can you watch time and nudge?
Leo: Yep I can timekeep and nudge.
Samir: For debrief, quick asks: agree on a single numeric score per rubric section, and a 2-sentence comment. No long writeups. :+1:
Priya: Agreed. Maya — can you paste debrief doc link when ready and make sure it's editable for the interviewers?
Maya: Done — https://docs.google.com/example/debrief-finalround (edit access for panel). 
Jordan: One more: if candidate asks about compensation band, redirect to recruiting@redwood.ai — don't answer on the call.
Priya: Noted. Also, if any panelist needs to swap last minute, DM me and cc people-ops. We still have a backup: Aaron is on standby.
Leo: Quick technical logistic — shared whiteboard link: https://miro.com/board/xyz. Use incognito if you can't access.
Elena: Small rubric clarification: for 'communication', is 3 considered "clear but minor gaps" or "occasionally unclear"? I want alignment.
Jordan: Use rubric note: 3 = "clear with minor gaps (would not block collaboration)"; 2 = "occasionally unclear or missing structure".
Samir: Thanks — that's helpful.
Priya: Final checklist: mic/headset ok, slides requested, docs link shared, debrief lead = Maya, timekeeper = Leo, weights confirmed. See you in 30. :rocket:
Maya: See you — will kick off the doc and start recording notes (not the Zoom recording).
Interview Bot: Post-interview reminder scheduled for 1h after end time to submit numeric scores.
Priya: Awesome. If anything changes ping here and @people-ops.
